meta.title: Team
meta.description: Meet the LipoNexus leadership team — experts in lipid biochemistry, clinical diagnostics, and biotech commercialization.

hero.headline: The Team Behind the Breakthrough
hero.body: LipoNexus brings together world-class scientists, clinicians, and entrepreneurs united by a common goal: transforming how fatty liver disease is detected and managed.

members.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
members.title: Chief Executive Officer & Co-Founder
members.bio: Dr. Chen brings over 15 years of experience in biotech leadership and clinical diagnostics. She holds a PhD in Biochemistry from UCSD and completed postdoctoral training at the Salk Institute. Prior to founding LipoNexus, she led diagnostics programs at two San Diego-based biotechs.

members.name: Dr. Michael Torres
members.title: Chief Scientific Officer & Co-Founder
members.bio: Dr. Torres is a leading expert in lipid metabolism and hepatology. His laboratory at UCSD has published extensively on inflammatory lipid signaling in liver disease. He earned his MD/PhD from Harvard Medical School and completed his hepatology fellowship at Mayo Clinic.

members.name: Dr. Priya Sharma
members.title: VP, Assay Development
members.bio: Dr. Sharma is an expert in mass spectrometry-based lipidomics and clinical assay development. She previously led assay development at Quest Diagnostics and holds a PhD in Analytical Chemistry from MIT.

members.name: James Whitfield
members.title: VP, Business Development
members.bio: James has over a decade of experience in healthcare partnerships and commercialization strategy. He previously held business development roles at Illumina and Thermo Fisher Scientific, and holds an MBA from Wharton.

members.name: Prof. David Loomis, MD
members.title: Hepatology, Stanford University Medical Center
members.bio: Leading hepatologist with expertise in NAFLD/NASH clinical trials and disease staging.

members.name: Prof. Aiko Tanaka, PhD
members.title: Lipidomics, Scripps Research
members.bio: Pioneer in inflammatory lipid signaling and mass spectrometry-based biomarker discovery.

members.name: Dr. Robert Klein, MD, MBA
members.title: Clinical Diagnostics & Regulatory Strategy
members.bio: Former FDA Division Director with extensive experience in IVD regulatory pathways and reimbursement strategy.
